name: Loreform
tagline: dnd miniature maker: turn a text prompt or reference image into a print-ready STL miniature
description: Loreform is an AI DnD miniature maker for tabletop players. Describe a hero, monster or terrain piece in text, or upload a reference image, refine the model with AI edits, and download print-ready STL files with pre-built supports for FDM and resin printers. Works for D&D, Pathfinder, Warhammer and other tabletop games. New users get 20 starter credits (valid 7 days); paid plans from $19.99/mo include commercial licensing.
